svg.text: PRDM · Parallel Retentive Diffusion Model (T = 1000 steps)
Multi-scale retention: Ret(X) = (QK⊤ ⊙ D) V , Dnm = γ|n−m|
4 heads · learnable decay γ · SwiGLU FFN · GroupNorm + swish gate
APDM / CSGM · Affordance Prediction Diffusion (N = 500 steps)
8 key joints: pelvis, upper back, feet, shoulders, wrists —
each with a contact probability and a contact point on the object.
ℒ = ℒdiffusion + 0.1 · ℒcontrast + 0.05 · ℒsmooth , ℒsmooth = E ‖ x̂t+1 − x̂t ‖²
contact points of ŷ₀ posed by x̂₀ᵒ → L × k × 3
update xt−1 at every denoising step
